top_signals.title: 'The House Is Losing': Mike Contopoulos
top_signals.summary: Mike Contopoulos, head of multi-asset macro investing at Janus Henderson, and Kay Herr, US CIO of US GFICC JPMorgan Asset Management, join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." This week Treasury Secretary Bessent announced that “I am the house now.” He was talking about the yen, but he also has said he wants yields to be lower. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
